description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Triniform, adding {C}{C}.
When Phyrexian Triniform dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Phyrexian Triniform trigger, creating three creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Phyrexian Triniform from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
